messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "medicine containing sacubitril"
set: ["medicine containing sacubitril", "another medicine containing spironolactone", "another medicine containing bupropion", "patients taking medicine containing rilpivirine", "cold or allergy medicine containing decongestant", "medication containing aliskiren", "products containing potassium", "supplements containing potassium", "supplements containing biotin", "HIV medication containing rilpivirine", "prescription medicines containing alcohol", "over-the-counter medicines containing alcohol", "antacids containing aluminum or magnesium", "other medicines containing venlafaxine or desvenlafaxine", "products containing salicylates, ibuprofen, ketoprofen, or naproxen", "hair, skin, or nail supplement containing biotin"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
